note: Session discovery used actual FastF1 event schedule (Session1-Session5) rather than hard-coded identifiers. 2023 Sprint Shootout sessions are requested using the FastF1 schedule name 'Sprint Shootout'. 2024+ Sprint Qualifying requested as 'Sprint Qualifying'. A race weekend is marked complete only when all required sessions (Race, Qualifying) are present. The race_weekends.successfully_fetched count is derived from full_fetch_progress.json completed_events (103), which is the authoritative record.
